run_googletest_catch_exceptions_test: run the googletest catch exceptions test suite to verify C++ and SEH exception handling behavior
test_CatchCxxExceptionsTest_fixture_cons: test that C++ exceptions thrown in a test fixture constructor are caught and logged correctly
test_CatchCxxExceptionsTest_SetUpTestSui: test that C++ exceptions thrown in SetUpTestSuite are caught and remaining test lifecycle methods still execute
test_CatchCxxExceptionsTest_test_body: test that C++ exceptions thrown in the test body are caught and TearDown methods still execute
test_CatchCxxExceptionsTest_unhandled_ex: test that unhandled C++ exceptions abort the program when catch_exceptions is disabled
